text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing the swelling in your right knee, and does it improve or worsen with activity?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Systemic or Oligoarticular type), given the 18-month duration, unilateral onset without trauma, and strong family history of similar issues. REQUEST IMAGES: Knee_X_Ray_Right, Knee_Ultrasound_Right.
